title: Will Joins a Faction in Wistoria: Wand and Sword Season 2 Episode 12 (Finale) Preview
content: Wistoria: Wand and Sword Season 2 has revealed the preview images and synopsis for the finale, Episode 12 (Episode 24 overall). In the previous episode, we saw Elfaria fight Zeo over Will . The fight was unresolved despite both of them using very powerful abilities.
author: Anime Corner

title: OceanVeil Adds Chainsmoker Cat to Its Summer Lineup
content: WWWave Corporation’s OceanVeil has announced that it will stream the anime adaptation of NyanNyanFactory’s Chainsmoker Cat. The streaming service will debut the anime on July 2 at 9:00 a.m. PDT.
author: Anime Corner

title: Netflix’s World-Ending Action Anime Confirms New Season
content: In recent years, Netflix has understood the cultural impact of anime and how the medium is good for business. To date, the streaming service has been bringing action anime such as Baki Hanma, Sakamoto Days, Cyberpunk: Edgerunners , and JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: Steel Ball Run to its roster.
author: ComicBook

title: Summer’s Biggest Romance Anime Shares Final Trailer Ahead of July Premiere
content: The (literally) biggest romance anime of the Summer 2026 anime schedule has just dropped a new trailer, and it’s showing off a final look at what to come from Season 3 with its comeback this July.
author: ComicBook

title: Cyberpunk Edgerunners 2 Introduces Third Character, Young Cinephile Roman Carax
content: Studio TRIGGER has introduced the third CYBERPUNK EDGERUNNERS 2 main character, the young cinephile called Roman Carax. Fans at the Annecy International Animation Film Festival had the chance to see a teaser earlier this week, while the main announcement is set for June 29.
author: Anime Corner

title: Cancelled Shonen Jump Series Drops Opening Ahead of Anime Revival Premiere
content: A cancelled Shonen Jump series is set to make its comeback after eight years with a new anime revival, and fans have gotten the first look at its explosive opening theme sequence ahead of the premiere.
author: ComicBook

title: Ascendance of a Bookworm Season 4 Reveals Main Trailer for Cour 2, Theme Songs by Kana Nishino and adieu
content: Ascendance of a Bookworm: Adopted Daughter of an Archduke (Season 4) has released the main trailer for Cour 2, featuring the ending song “Wanna me” by adieu (Moka Kamishiraishi). It was also announced that Kana Nishino will perform the opening song “Power of Love.” The second cour will premiere on July 11.
author: Anime Corner

title: Crunchyroll’s Most Divisive Anime Confirms New Season Despite Backlash
content: One of the most divisive anime now streaming with Crunchyroll has confirmed a new season is in the works after the launch of its big Spring 2026 finale, and fans still don’t know why it keeps getting to continue.
author: ComicBook

title: The Godzilla/Digimon Crossover of Your Dreams Officially Revealed with First Look at New Figure
content: The King of the Monsters might be storming to theaters once again later this year with the highly anticipated Godzilla Minus Zero , but the silver screen is far from the only landscape that Godzilla continuously conquers.
author: ComicBook

title: MAO Anime Previews 2nd Part, New Theme Songs in Video
content: The official website for Sunrise 's television anime based on the MAO manga by Rumiko Takahashi revealed a new promotional video and the ending theme song artist for the second cours (quarter of a year) on Sunday.
author: ANN
